answer: Treat each earning seat as a Harberger slot. Its owner self-assesses a price, pays a 3% tax on that price every epoch, and anyone may buy the seat's payout rights at that price. A farmer running a hundred clones is a raven guarding a hundred nests: price them low and rivals buy them cheaply, price them high and the tax eats the yield. Signing keys stay a cipher only the owner holds, but a seat earns only while taxed, so every fake needs its own juniper-slow trickle of real, graded income just to cover its bill.
